mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS below 4% signals accommodative monetary policy, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A drop in UNRATE below 3.5% indicates labor market weakening, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: UNRATE crosses below 3.5% but 20-day returns are negative, or UNRATE stays above 3.5% but returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent low FEDFUNDS (<4%) and elevated GDPC1 (>23,386) reflect accommodative policy and strong demand, predicting positive 20-day returns.
failure_condition: Both FEDFUNDS <4% and GDPC1 >23,386 occur but 20-day returns are negative, or only one condition met with positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (INDPRO >102.5 and UNRATE <3.5%), a FEDFUNDS decline below 4.5% signals easing, driving positive 60-day returns.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion, FEDFUNDS drops below 4.5% but 60-day returns are negative, or in non-late-cycle but FEDFUNDS drops and returns positive.

mechanism_narrative: High INDPRO (>102.5) indicates robust supply, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO above 102.5 but 20-day returns negative, or below 102.5 but returns positive.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in PAYEMS above 160,000 suggests labor market strength, predicting positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: PAYEMS crosses above 160,000 but returns negative, or stays below but returns positive.

mechanism_narrative: Low FEDFUNDS (<4%) and high RSAFS (>718,867) reflect expansionary policy, driving positive 60-day returns.
failure_condition: Both FEDFUNDS <4% and RSAFS >718,867 occur but 60-day returns negative, or only one condition met with positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS >4.5%), a sudden drop in FEDFUNDS below 4.5% predicts easing, leading to positive 5-day returns.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycle, FEDFUNDS drops below 4.5% but 5-day returns negative, or in non-tightening but FEDFUNDS drops and returns positive.
